query: UPDATE agent_team_members m SET state = CASE WHEN i.execution_status = 'queued' THEN 'queued' ELSE 'working' END, last_read_seq = GREATEST(m.last_read_seq, COALESCE((SELECT CASE WHEN m.round > 1 THEN MAX(a.seq) ELSE MIN(a.seq) END FROM channel_messages a JOIN agent_teams t ON t.channel_id = a.channel_id WHERE t.id = m.team_id AND a.to_conversation = m.conversation_id AND a.type = 'assign'), 0)) FROM idempotency i WHERE m.state = 'starting' AND i.conversation_id = m.conversation_id AND i.key = CASE WHEN m.round > 1 THEN 'team-round:' || m.conversation_id::text || ':' || m.round ELSE 'team-start:' || m.conversation_id::text END
